Windows x64 ControlCAN SDK library from Waveshare USB-CAN-B official secondary development package.
Source: https://files.waveshare.com/wiki/USB-CAN-B/Demo/lib/Secondary-lib-dll.zip
Documentation: https://www.waveshare.com/wiki/USB-CAN-B
Manufacturer library; not covered by the application license.
USB driver must be installed separately.
